In case of bunch bids, the primary product having highest value should meet this criterion. 6. Generic OPTION CLAUSE: The Purchaser reserves the right to increase or decrease the quantity to be ordered up to 50 percent of bid quantity at the time of placement of contract. The purchaser also reserves the right to increase the ordered quantity up to 50% of the contracted quantity during the currency of the contract at the contracted rates. The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. The additional delivery time shall be (Increased quantity ÷ Original quantity) × Original delivery period (in days), subject to minimum of 30 days. If the original delivery period is less than 30 days, the additional time equals the original delivery period. The Purchaser may extend this calculated delivery duration up to the original delivery period while exercising the option clause. Bidders must comply with these terms. 8. Generic Supplier shall ensure that the Invoice is raised in the name of Consignee with GSTIN of Consignee only. 9. Generic The Buyer has an existing set up / inventory of similar products. The offered / supplied product must be compatible with existing system. The bidder has to ensure Compatibility of the supplied items or shall have to include in the supply the necessary hardware / software to make them compatible at no extra cost to the buyer. The details of items with which compatibility is required are as under: Deckel CNC machine 10. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses **Introduction to the Project: Upgradation of Deckel CNC machine with updated Fagor 8058 elite CNC system on turn key basis. **Terms & Conditions: 1. Position accuracies and repeatability are to be checked and recorded before start of work and end of the work. 2. Positional accuracies of machine will be confirmed by doing sample component before start of work and same component after change of control system. Similar jobs also will be machines to ensure the cons istency. Necessary programming support is to be given. 3. Man-power (technical/helpers), tools & tackles, lifting equipment etc required for successful executio n of work are under vendor’s scope. (Note: There is no EOT/Overhead crane facility near the machine). 4. Vendor must provide on-site training on operation, programming and maintenance on CNC System a nd its features for a minimum period of 3 days. 5. Material is to be supplied to BDL stores in a proper packing condition. 6. Delivery Period: Material is to be delivered within 60 days from date of receipt PO by vendor. Wor k completion period (ICT) is 120 days from date of receipt of PO by vendor.

7. Vendor must submit availability of spares & service support for the proposed CNC System for a mini mum period of 10 years issued by OEM **Security deposit (SD): SD for 5% of order value shall be deposited by the successful bidder within 15 days from the date of award of contract. The SD shall be returned upon satisfactory execution of the order and submission of ee-PBG ** Performance Bank Guarantee: The vendor shall submit performance bank guarantee (e-PBG) in the prescribed form for 10% of the order value covering the warranty period plus 03 months of claim period. FOR **Payment Terms: (refer specification document) 1. Payment will be recommended only after successful supply, installation, commissioning, testing and pro ving of machine for normal functionality. 2. No advance payment or intermittent payment will be done. 3. Party should submit the invoice along with all supporting documents for processing of payment. 4. Payment will be done within 30days from date of submission of invoice & supporting documents along w ith work completion letter. 5. EMD as per GeM Conditions, Bank Guarantee (ePBG) (Maximum 5% of Order value, till warranty expires) is applicable. READ AS **Payment Terms: i) 90% payment (along with 100% taxes) shall be released within 30 days against submission of Tax Invoic e and work completion certificate duly certified by the User Dept. The vendor must successfully complete t he supply, installation, Testing, Commissioning and Proving of the CNC machine for normal Functionality. ii) Balance 10% payment shall be released against submission of performance bank Guarantee(e-PBG) for 10% value of the Order covering the warranty period plus 03 months claim period. iii) BDL reserves its right to release GST only after supplier's invoice/debit note is reflected in GSTR-2B/2A within the specified time limit mentioned in GST Law. iv) Submission of Invoice by Seller with shortfall of mandatory documents and delivery proofs is not accept able and is deemed to be rejected. *** WARRANTY: Vendor has to provide warranty for the the supplied items and workmanship(including m anufacturing defects) for a minimum of 12 (Twelve) from the date of successful completion of work. .
